title: Clinical Decision Rule for Pediatric Intracranial Pathology
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to develop a clinical decision rule for patients seen in the pediatric emergency department for possible intracranial pathology. This a prospective study evaluating patients presenting with headache and migraine. The study is observational and does not impact patient care.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 6-18 years
* Chief complaint of headache or migraine

Exclusion Criteria:

* Exclusion criteria
* Head trauma within 48 hours
* Previous neurosurgery (shunt included)
* Personal history of brain tumor
* History of stroke or vascular abnormality
* Sickle Cell Disease
* Fever (temperature over 38 degrees C)
study_population: Patients presenting to the ED with Headache or Migraine who meet the inclusion criteria and do not meet any exclusion criteria.
